assertions.evidence: The print-mode run returned INTERACTION_REQUIRED instead of fabricating a native interaction.
The result preserved both the color and token questions, their fixed choices, the recommendation, and custom-input allowance.
The exact terminal result ended with responses: null.
Amber remained a recommendation only; the result contains no selected color or token.
The result did not emit INTERACTION_RESULT or any success field.
External post-run Git status showed only probe session directories as untracked and no tracked project changes.

limitations: This proves the declared pause-and-return fallback for OMP print mode; it does not make print mode natively interactive.
OMP remains overall D0 because its separate plugin-manager dry-run probe failed the D1 safety gate.
